tours.description: How to get the exact list of vendors ranked by credit value: open Journal Items, filter to Payable, group by Partner, then sort by the Credit column to bring the largest vendor credits to the top.

steps.content: Click Journal Items to open the full list of accounting entry lines.

steps.title: Payable
steps.content: Under Filters, click Payable to keep only vendor payable lines.

steps.content: Under Group By, click Partner to total the figures per vendor.

steps.title: Credit
steps.content: Click the Credit column header once. This sorts the vendors by credit, smallest first.

steps.title: Credit
steps.content: Click the Credit column header a second time. The arrow flips and the vendors with the highest credit move to the top of the list.
